graph.baseline: portable + no-AB12 FFN + native FA4 + fixed QKV-only cuBLASLt id70

method.offset_basis: 35 us approximates one heavy trunk stage; 70 us approximates half a block; 140 us approximates one block
method.interpretation: short diagnostic only; no offset is retained without a clear result outside ordinary run-to-run noise

decision.reason: All offsets are within approximately 0.25% and none consistently exceeds the synchronized zero-offset control. A one-shot phase seed does not create a measurable steady-state gain for the fixed id70 graph.
